parameters.content:
## What this does
Nightly ETL that mirrors Krayin's MariaDB tables we care about into the metrics warehouse (Postgres).

## When it fires
Cron 02:00 Asia/Dubai every day.

## What's downstream
Metabase dashboards (Funnel, Channel performance, Stage velocity, Cost per booked call) all read from `warehouse` Postgres.

## KPI it affects
The entire Section 2 funnel set. If this workflow doesn't run for >24h, all dashboards go stale.

## Kill criterion
If >2 consecutive failures: pause and investigate (most likely cause = Krayin schema drift).

## Credentials needed
- `Krayin MariaDB (read-only)` — MySQL node creds, host=krayin-db port=3306 db=krayin user=krayin
- `Warehouse Postgres` — Postgres node creds, host=metrics-db port=5432 db=warehouse user=warehouse_admin

See UNDERWINGS-MASTER-PLAN.md §7/B.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ops.etl_runs (started_at, status) VALUES (NOW(), 'running') RETURNING id;
SELECT id, name, is_default, rotten_days, created_at, updated_at FROM lead_pipelines;

=INSERT INTO raw.lead_pipelines (id, name, is_default, rotten_days, created_at, updated_at, synced_at)
VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, $$ {{ $json.name }} $$, {{ $json.is_default }}, {{ $json.rotten_days }}, $$ {{ $json.created_at }} $$::timestamp, $$ {{ $json.updated_at }} $$::timestamp, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  is_default = EXCLUDED.is_default,
  rotten_days = EXCLUDED.rotten_days,
  updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at,
  synced_at = NOW();
SELECT id, lead_pipeline_id, name, sort_order, probability FROM lead_pipeline_stages;

=INSERT INTO raw.lead_pipeline_stages (id, lead_pipeline_id, name, sort_order, probability, synced_at)
VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, {{ $json.lead_pipeline_id }}, $$ {{ $json.name }} $$, {{ $json.sort_order }}, {{ $json.probability }}, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  lead_pipeline_id = EXCLUDED.lead_pipeline_id,
  name = EXCLUDED.name, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order,
  probability = EXCLUDED.probability, synced_at = NOW();

=INSERT INTO raw.lead_sources (id, name, synced_at) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, $$ {{ $json.name }} $$, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, synced_at = NOW();

=INSERT INTO raw.lead_types (id, name, synced_at) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, $$ {{ $json.name }} $$, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, synced_at = NOW();

SELECT l.id, l.title, l.description, l.lead_value, l.status, l.lost_reason, l.closed_at, l.expected_close_date, l.lead_pipeline_id, l.lead_pipeline_stage_id, l.lead_source_id, l.lead_type_id, l.user_id, l.person_id, l.organization_id, l.created_at, l.updated_at, (SELECT av.text_value FROM attribute_values av JOIN attributes a ON a.id = av.attribute_id WHERE av.entity_id = l.id AND av.entity_type = 'leads' AND a.code = 'icp_segment' LIMIT 1) AS icp_segment, (SELECT av.integer_value FROM attribute_values av JOIN attributes a ON a.id = av.attribute_id WHERE av.entity_id = l.id AND av.entity_type = 'leads' AND a.code = 'outbound_confidence_score' LIMIT 1) AS outbound_confidence_score, (SELECT av.integer_value FROM attribute_values av JOIN attributes a ON a.id = av.attribute_id WHERE av.entity_id = l.id AND av.entity_type = 'leads' AND a.code = 'client_health_score' LIMIT 1) AS client_health_score FROM leads l;

=INSERT INTO raw.leads (id, title, description, lead_value, status, lost_reason, closed_at, expected_close_date, lead_pipeline_id, lead_pipeline_stage_id, lead_source_id, lead_type_id, user_id, person_id, organization_id, icp_segment, outbound_confidence_score, client_health_score, created_at, updated_at, synced_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  $$ {{ $json.title }} $$,
  $$ {{ $json.description || '' }} $$,
  {{ $json.lead_value || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.status === null || $json.status === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.status }},
  $$ {{ $json.lost_reason || '' }} $$,
  {{ $json.closed_at ? "$$ " + $json.closed_at + " $$::timestamp" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.expected_close_date ? "$$ " + $json.expected_close_date + " $$::date" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.lead_pipeline_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.lead_pipeline_stage_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.lead_source_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.lead_type_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.user_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.person_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.organization_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.icp_segment ? "$$ " + $json.icp_segment + " $$" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.outbound_confidence_score || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.client_health_score || 'NULL' }},
  $$ {{ $json.created_at }} $$::timestamp,
  $$ {{ $json.updated_at }} $$::timestamp,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description, lead_value=EXCLUDED.lead_value,
  status=EXCLUDED.status, lost_reason=EXCLUDED.lost_reason, closed_at=EXCLUDED.closed_at,
  expected_close_date=EXCLUDED.expected_close_date, lead_pipeline_id=EXCLUDED.lead_pipeline_id,
  lead_pipeline_stage_id=EXCLUDED.lead_pipeline_stage_id, lead_source_id=EXCLUDED.lead_source_id,
  lead_type_id=EXCLUDED.lead_type_id, user_id=EXCLUDED.user_id, person_id=EXCLUDED.person_id,
  organization_id=EXCLUDED.organization_id, icp_segment=EXCLUDED.icp_segment,
  outbound_confidence_score=EXCLUDED.outbound_confidence_score, client_health_score=EXCLUDED.client_health_score,
  updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at, synced_at=NOW();
UPDATE ops.etl_runs SET finished_at = NOW(), status = 'success' WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM ops.etl_runs WHERE status = 'running');
